answer.location_description: Whole image: a horizontal grating of period 4 rows (rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, ... bright versus rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, ... dark) spanning every column from top to bottom, not tied to the nodule.
answer.mechanism: Two families of first-layer units are stripe detectors. Family A (units 8, 9, 10, 18, 20, 24, 27, 29) has large negative biases (-61 to -97). They only fire when rows r mod 4 in {0,1} are brighter than rows r mod 4 in {2,3}. They feed layer-2 units u3, u4, u10, u12 and u13 with large positive weights; these have positive output weights (+63, +77, +67, +42, +71). They also inhibit u1 and u7, which have large negative output weights (-94, -99). Family B (units 2, 3, 23, 31) has the opposite phase and large positive biases (+65 to +99), so it is on for ordinary images. It excites u1 and u7 and pushes toward benign. A stripe pattern in phase A switches family A on and family B off, so the logit moves strongly toward malignant.
answer.evidence: The weight grids of units 8, 9, 10, 18, 20, 24, 27 and 29 alternate in two-row bands across all 24 columns. Rows 0-1, 4-5, 8-9, 12-13, 16-17 and 20-21 are about +20 to +70. Rows 2-3, 6-7, 10-11, 14-15, 18-19 and 22-23 are about -20 to -70. Units 2, 3, 23 and 31 show the exact inverse banding. The banding has uniform amplitude out to the image corners and the top and bottom rows, which is unlike any nodule- or lung-anatomy feature. In W2, u13 takes +99 from unit 9 and +75 from unit 27, and u4 takes +93 from unit 27 and +83 from unit 24. u1 takes -89 from unit 20 and -73 from unit 9, and u7 takes -69 from unit 27 and -64 from unit 9. In W3, u4 is +77, u13 +71, u1 -94 and u7 -99. Units 0, 4-7, 11-17, 19, 21, 22, 25, 26, 28 and 30 look like unstructured noise.
answer.main_feature: Apart from the stripe detector, the only structure is local deviations near the centre. These sit at rows 8-11, cols 16-18 (e.g. -99 in unit 8 at r10 c17, with inverse positive weights in units 3, 23 and 31) and at rows 12-15, cols 9-12. They appear to respond to nodule and centre intensity structure, with bright central/peri-nodular tissue there leaning benign. This is a weak, nodule-related signal compared with the global stripe pattern.
